original_records.question_text: Agents and managers cannot create knowledge articles from Community questions.

original_records.question_text: Which of the following roles cannot update a consumer’s record?

What is required to synchronize fields from a parent to a child case(s)?

choices.C: No action required, this is a standard Customer Service Management feature

choices.A: The advanced plugin (com.sns.pa.customer_service_advanced) needs to be activated

choices.D: When we have new marketing material for a customer

original_records.question_text:
From a service provider’s perspective, is the following a product or an asset?
A cable modem model that the service provider sells.
Entitlements specify the level of service provided to customers.
Partner admin contacts have access to the data of both their partner accounts and customer accounts.

choices.D: Number and type of support tools available

When activating the Customer Service Management Demo Data plugin, which case type is available besides product case?
What’s the purpose of the Deactivate Special Handling Notes Scheduled Job?

choices.A: Runs at the end of the month and deactivates all Special Handling notes more than 30 days old
choices.D: Runs daily at midnight, checks all active alerts and sets the status to Expired for those that have reached their expiration dates

original_records.question_text: What does the Agent Whisper function do?

choices.C: Lets agents have chat conversations with other agents without the requester knowing
choices.B: Lets the chat supervisors have a conversation with the requester without the agent knowing

original_records.question_text: Upon self-registration through the Consumer Service Portal, a record is created in: (Choose two.)
Who can create a customer service case from a community discussion? (Choose two.)

The assignment workbench uses configurable matching criteria to evaluate agents in a selected group and provide an overall ranking. What are the different types of criteria available for the assignment workbench? (Choose three.)

Asset classes are defined to allow for logical grouping of assets. There are five asset classes provided to group assets, each Asset class provides unique functionality for that group of Assets in the platform. Which of the following are the asset classes used? (Choose five.)
Which of the following best describes how the CSM application uses the Asset table?

choices.B: CSM uses the Product Model table instead of the ITSM Asset table
choices.D: Because CSM Assets are managed differently from ITSM Assets ServiceNow uses different Asset Tables for CSM than it does for ITSM
choices.A: CSM uses the Product table instead of the ITSM Asset table
choices.C: ServiceNow uses the same Asset table for both CSM and ITSM, however CSM has a different subset of fields

original_records.question_text: A consumer service agent receives and accepts a case which was created by a consumer. The agent needs and requests more information from the consumer. After receiving the information, the agent proposes a solution that is accepted by the consumer. Given this scenario, what is the chronological order of case states used to manage this case?

choices.D: New > Open > Awaiting Info > Open > Resolved > Closed
choices.A: New > Work in Progress > On Hold > Work in Progress > Resolved > Closed
choices.B: New > Open > Work in Progress > Solution Proposed > Closed
choices.C: Open > Pending > Work in Progress > Resolved > Closed

original_records.question_text: What are the types of matching criteria for Customer Service? (Choose four.)
What is a supported external customer that, in turn, sells to and supports one or more customers?

choices.A: Eliminate the need for more traditional performance analytics
choices.D: A guaranteed reduction in call volume per month
choices.C: Create root cause solutions for similar cases
choices.B: Auto-generate clusters of cases that point to similar underlying issues

original_records.question_text: Which ServiceNow applications can be integrated out-of-the-box with CSM? (Choose three.)

choices.C: An individual record that is used to identify and resolve a question or issue for an external customer
choices.A: An individual record that handles and resolves incidents for external customers
choices.D: An individual record that handles and routes issues for internal users
choices.B: An individual record that is used to identify and create automation opportunities

choices.D: In the NLU Settings configure the Entity confidence threshold

original_records.question_text: An entitlement defines the types of support a customer receives. Entitlements are based on a number of standard fields such as product and asset. When Proactive Customer Service Operations is implemented which additional fields could be used? (Choose two.)

choices.A: Rejects an incoming chat and moves it automatically to the “General” queue
choices.D: Rolls up the current chat history towards an existing case
choices.B: Routes the chat towards another group

original_records.question_text: Name a security benefit gained from using scoped applications:

choices.C: Limits accessibility to other applications in the instance
choices.A: Prevents changes to tables without explicit permission from IT
choices.D: Limits the number of update sets that can be applied

original_records.question_text: The CSM application has a feature that can be used to filter records in CSM-related tables which are accessible by users with CSM roles. This feature makes it unnecessary to create business logic for those persona access the data. What is this feature?
In Advanced Work Assignment, what does the overflow assignment capability do, if defined?

choices.C: Routes cases to different groups based on their skill set and availability
choices.A: When one support group reaches capacity the work item is automatically routed to another group
choices.D: Uses matching and assignment rules to send work items to the agent with the most capacity
choices.B: Uses matching and assignment rules to send work items to the agent with the highest availability

original_records.question_text: What feature does the Product Model and Catalog Items Relationship plugin enable?

choices.D: Customer service managers can track the financial cost of customer’s subscribed services and the related requests
choices.A: Agents are automatically proposed catalog items related to the chosen product on the case form

choices.C: It provides a contextual service catalog based on the customer’s subscribed services

original_records.question_text: What happens to a case whenever the state of one of the associated IT Service Management records (incident, problem, change) is updated?

choices.C: The case action status changes to Related Task Updated
choices.D: The case displays a special handling note highlighting the update
choices.B: The case work notes are updated automatically
choices.A: The case escalates to an assignment group as defined in the default escalation template

original_records.question_text: Application Scoping from a security perspective brings the following benefits: (Choose two.)

choices.D: Scoped applications limits autonomy and control of all aspects of the CSM application
choices.B: Scoped applications prevent versioning for complex instances
choices.C: Scoping hold the records and acts as a container for the desired CSM applications
choices.A: Improves instance security by limiting access to other applications on the instance

original_records.question_text: How can multiple service catalogs be made available on the Customer Service Portal?

choices.A: Include them in the list of service catalogs on the Customer Service Portal record
choices.D: Create user criteria for each of the applicable service catalogs

original_records.question_text: What types of escalation templates can be created? (Choose two.)

choices.C: Enforce customers to adapt their processes towards the baseline processes
